tools.name: get_ftse100_today
tools.description: How the news treated the FTSE 100 on the latest day (or a given day): overall mood, the biggest stories and every company's tone score (−10 clearly bad news for the company … +10 clearly good).

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: A FTSE 100 company's news dashboard: latest day's tone and why, 30-day average, last 7 days vs the week before, a written overview of the last month, the stories that moved the tone, and day-by-day history.

tools.name: get_company_day
tools.description: Every scored headline about a company on one day, each with its tone, outlet, link, the reason for its score and the story it belongs to.

tools.name: get_story
tools.description: One news story (an event covered across outlets and days): summary, tone, timeline and every headline.

tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Search every FTSE 100 story or headline MarketFrame has scored.

tools.name: get_weekly_note
tools.description: The Monday weekly note on FTSE 100 news tone: which companies had the best and worst coverage and why.
